subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository approve this 14-action batch, including the revisions executed with GitHub App private keys, registry credentials, and OpenAI credentials, for the current merge result?
rationale: This is a trusted third-party-code and credential-boundary decision; mechanical pin updates and ordinary CI cannot determine the repository's acceptable supply-chain trust level.

options.title: Approve the audited action set
options.body: Confirm the official pinned revisions and their credential-boundary behavior, then rebase and merge once the exact resulting head completes required checks.

options.title: Hold for narrower review
options.body: Split or pause the batch so token-, registry-, and Codex-action revisions receive dedicated review before they run in privileged workflows.

recommendation.title: Approve the audited action set
recommendation.body: Confirm the official pinned revisions and their credential-boundary behavior, then rebase and merge once the exact resulting head completes required checks.
